chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Meeting Louis Armstrong on the St. Louis riverboat
summary: They play opposite Floyd Campbell's band where Louis Armstrong plays; he later remembers Mosley and hires him.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: That's right, this is where Randolph, Mouse Randolph comes in the band around this time. When you came out of St. Louis is the time when you played on the boat; right?
You played opposite Floyd Campbell's band; they hired Louie, they said Louis had to play with Floyd Campbells band.
Yes; with us--they played against us.
This is the first time that you really became aware of Louis?
Yes; that's right, that's where I first met Louie. That's one of the reasons why I joined Louie later --

He remembered me, and that was another thrill in my life, when Louie called me up. I was with Fats, you know, but when Louie--when the Great Louie called me--I forgot all about Fats. Fats was a great band all right--
Fats wasn't working all that steady; was he?
He worked fairly well. I don't mean that he wasn't a good

musician, because Fats was a wonderful musician too, but Fats was more of a jive guy. Louie Armstrong was a guy that you would, as a musician, you would admire--he would be the most that you would want to be like. He was a great influence on my life.
We really brought Louie down to St. Louis to play with us.
He stayed down in St. Louis with us for a whole week and played with us.
